changelog: New voice command "cut last paragraph" — say "cut last paragraph" alone while dictating (or "শেষ অনুচ্ছেদ কেটে নাও") and the last paragraph before the cursor is cut to the clipboard in one step: it leaves the message and is ready to paste anywhere. Before, you had to say "copy last paragraph" and then "delete last paragraph" separately. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
